## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title uses Conventional Commit syntax, such as
      `fix: correct PDF loading` or `feat(editor): add page cropping`.
- [ ] Every authored commit subject uses the same convention.
- [ ] The selected type reflects the intended release impact: `fix:` for a
      patch, `feat:` for a minor release, and `!` for a breaking release.
